request: Make vehicle plate optional for pallet returns
setup: Existing test tooling only; isolated bounded containers and mocked NetSuite; no dependency or schema changes.
scenarios: P1 Pallet-only returns accept omitted, empty or whitespace vehicle plates and create one verified Credit Memo; replay cannot create another.
P2 A supplied plate is normalized and retained; the existing 32-character limit still applies.
P3 Stock-containing returns still require a vehicle plate; photo, quantity, yard and posting checks remain in force.
P4 Operator review labels a pallet-only vehicle plate Optional and permits confirmation without it.
P5 A Credit Memo for a blank-plate return omits an empty plate label from its memo.
